room_description: A classic dining room featuring a long table set with candles, a sofa, a green potted plant, a large birdcage holding a parrot, and a white sideboard cabinet.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the classic dining room.
Inspects the decorative brown cushions on the sofa.
Finds a small key sitting inside a bowl on the white cabinet.
Uses the key to unlock the top drawer of the white cabinet.
Collects a loaf of bread resting on a plate on the dining table.
Holds a large green leaf over a lit candle on the dining table.
Reveals a hidden pattern of glowing green dashes on the leaf.
Enters the dash pattern into the lock at the bottom of the cabinet.
Completes a sliding jigsaw puzzle on a tablet found inside the drawer.
Enters the calculated code '835' into the padlock on the birdcage.

solution_steps: Collect the large green leaf from the potted plant.
Hold the leaf over the heat of the lit candle on the dining table to reveal a dash pattern.
puzzles.reward: Dash code for the cabinet lock

solution_steps: Solve the Roman ruins jigsaw puzzle on the tablet.
The tablet then displays three items: a chair, a cushion, and a candle.
Count these specific items in the room (8 chairs, 3 cushions, 5 candles) to form the code.
Enter the code '835' into the padlock to open the birdcage.
Feed the bread to the parrot inside so it drops the key from its beak.

final_action: Collects the key dropped by the parrot and uses it to unlock the main door.
